## Work with R or study offline

- [Download the complete student RStudio project](downloads/applied-statistics-rstudio.zip): editable lessons, teaching CSVs, images, and setup instructions. Extract the ZIP, then open `Applied-Statistics.Rproj` in RStudio.
- [Download all three PDFs](downloads/applied-statistics-pdfs.zip).

The online lessons and PDFs show the code and its results. To run or change R code, use the RStudio project.
